prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant

assessments.note: Only Python shown; needs second primary language.
Demonstrated full-stack design, build, ship production apps.
Experience with AI/LLM APIs and prompt engineering.
Prompt engineering and tool-calling agent skills present.
Used Claude Code tool in projects.
Mentoring and onboarding show strong communication.
Led end-to-end projects, certified in project management.
Sales and CRM roles provide customer-facing experience.
Autonomous work in fast-changing projects demonstrated.
Rapid prototyping demos based on client feedback.
ETL and CRM integration experience evident.
Sales role suggests travel but not explicit.
Bachelor's degree in progress, not completed.

output.verdict_line: Candidate largely meets the role requirements but lacks a second primary language, completed bachelor's degree, and confirmed travel willingness.
top_gaps: Experience with at least two primary languages (.Net, NodeJS, Python, Java, Ruby)
